_note: The drive rule (BETA_CONVERSATION_SPEC 2.3): every reply except care (and a student who said stop) ends with the next step, one question or one concrete action. The Writer returns it as the JSON field next_step, posted as the reply's last line. The phase comes from the counselor journey stage. In a phase that asks, a reply allowed a question, or one of question_after_actions (answering a request), ends with the next bank question, else the next missing education basic (basic_question); otherwise with the phase line, a concrete action that names a workspace place. In the chosen phase, step_line names the chosen route's first open step (its roadmap.json copy). Lines are English; they are shown in the student's language through the rendered copy cache.

getting_to_know.line: Your Profile page shows what I know about you so far; tell me more about yourself whenever you like.

mirror.line: Open your Mirror and tell me what feels right and what feels wrong.

proposed.line: Your fields are on the Roadmap page: open it and pick the one you want to look at first.

chosen.line: Your next step is on the Roadmap page: open your route and do the first open step.
chosen.step_line: Your next step is {step}: open your route on the Roadmap page and tick it off when it is done.
